assessment: This is an important study that investigates the role of astrocytic Gi signaling in the anterior cingulate cortex in the modulation of extracellular L-lactate level and consequently impairment in flavor-place paired associates learning. The evidence supporting the authors' main conclusions is convincing. Additionally, the study provides compelling evidence to suggest the molecular mechanism by which astrocyte-produced L-lactate may influence mitochondrial biogenesis in neurons, thereby affecting schema memory. This study expands our understanding of how disruptions in astrocytic functions can impair cognitive processing and, therefore, could have clinical relevance.
